annotations.text: The palladium line. Press play to see it built step by step.
ME network: controller, drive, crafting CPU, Chance Pattern Controller and Programming Circuit Provider
Large Chemical Reactor, running the ammonia recycling and precipitation patterns
Cyclic Pattern Crafting Input Buffer, next to the ME output bus and hatch
Large Sifter, running the sift pattern
Programmable Crafting Input Buffer, receiving the sift pattern through a lane
Fluix ME glass cables join the hatches to one ME network
Left-click to record coordinates
Coordinates recorded; use this data stick to bind lane 1
Open the Cyclic Pattern Crafting Input Buffer, then click the plus button
Open the pattern popup: the precipitation pattern is in the first slot
Place the chance sifting pattern in the next slot of the same group
Place the ammonia recycling pattern in the third slot
All three patterns start on lane 0, running in this hatch
Scroll or click to change lanes; left-click the sifting pattern to select lane 1
The sifting slot turns blue for lane 1; both chemical patterns remain on lane 0
Open lane bindings; lane 1 is waiting for a target input hatch
The data stick stores the sifter input hatch position; carry it onto the lane 1 binding slot
Lane 1 is bound; its slot shows the target icon and the connected state
Sifting goes to the sifter through blue lane 1; precipitation and ammonia recycling run in this hatch
The configuration page shows the cycle multiplier and chance seed multiplier
The popup closes; the three patterns remain in the cyclic hatch
